mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is currently 72 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona has officially unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture in Century School Park. This beautiful piece, carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists, depicts various animals in Tai Chi poses and serves as a new welcoming art installation for the community.

There is a busy schedule today in Verona! You can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, participate in yoga at Insight Wellness, shop at the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, grab pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or test your knowledge at trivia night at The Bogey Factory.

For our weekly report, on August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail following reports of a vehicle window being intentionally smashed; the suspect fled the scene and currently has an active arrest warrant.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so make sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
